description.value: Good Taco is a mission-driven taqueria founded to help alleviate childhood poverty in Mexico, with proceeds supporting the Casa De Luz Children's Centre in Primo Tapia, Baja California. The Chilliwack location serves authentic Mexican street food — tacos, burritos, burrito bowls, and quesadillas — with traditional fillings like al pastor, carnitas, and carne asada. A dedicated social enterprise with operations in both Canada and Mexico, it offers a range of dietary-friendly options well suited to hungry touring cyclists.
